raw.title: Head of Product & Technology (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Cara Care is a leading German digital therapeutics company and part of Bayer, combining the agility of a growth-stage health tech company with the backing, scale, and credibility of a global healthcare leader. We build DiGA-listed products that deliver measurable clinical outcomes for patients and integrate deeply into the German healthcare system. Our ambition is to become a category leader in digital care by bringing together evidence-based medicine, outstanding user engagement, and scalable, compliant technology - while shaping how digital therapeutics connect to national health infrastructure and care delivery.

We are looking for a Head of Product & Technology  (m/f/x) to support us in our mission with immediate effect. In this role, you will be a key member of the Cara Care leadership team and report directly to the Managing Director of Cara Care. You will own the combined product and technology agenda across our DiGA products for IBS and GERD as well as our R&D portfolio. Your mission is to build a clinically effective, user-centric, compliant, and scalable digital therapeutics platform that strengthens Cara Care’s position as a category leader in digital care. 

You combine product leadership, technical depth, and regulated healthcare expertise. You set direction, create focus, build strong teams, and ensure that product discovery, engineering delivery, data/AI capabilities, and compliance requirements work together effectively.

🚀 Your Mission

  • Product and technology strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution across existing and future digital therapeutic offerings
  • End-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and delivery to optimization, engagement, and measurable patient impact
  • Engineering architecture across mobile/web frontend, backend services, data, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, security, and integrations
  • Data and AI capabilities, including analytics, personalization, automation, experimentation, and responsible AI-enabled product features
  • Translation of clinical, regulatory, reimbursement, privacy, and security requirements into pragmatic product and technology solutions
  • Software-as-a-medical-device lifecycle practices, including risk management, documentation discipline, change control, audit readiness, and post-market considerations
  • Operating model, delivery rhythms, decision rights, and ownership across Product, Engineering, Design, and Data/AI
  • Team leadership, hiring, coaching, and development of a high-performing, accountable, and learning-oriented organization
  • Senior stakeholder management across Cara Care, Bayer interfaces, external partners, healthcare ecosystem stakeholders, and relevant infrastructure initiatives

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • A focused product and technology roadmap is aligned with business, clinical, regulatory, and patient outcomes
  • Engineering delivery is more predictable, scalable, and transparent, with clear ownership and operating rhythms
  • The platform foundation supports multiple indications, future integrations, and compliant product evolution
  • Product engagement, therapy adherence, prescription activation, and patient impact are improved through data-informed iteration
  • Teams have clear roles, decision rights, and development paths, and are able to operate with speed and accountability in a regulated environment
  • Cara Care is prepared for audits, certification requirements, security reviews, and quality expectations by design rather than through late-stage remediation

Requirements

🤓 Your Profile

Must-Haves

  • Senior product and/or technology leadership experience at Head/VP level, with ownership of strategy, roadmap, delivery, and team performance
  • Strong product mindset and track record building consumer-facing or patient-facing digital products with measurable engagement, outcome, and business impact
  • Technical fluency across modern software architecture, including mobile/web frontend, backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, cybersecurity, and data platforms
  • Experience operating in regulated environments, with the ability to balance speed, quality, compliance, privacy, safety, and auditability
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, hiring, and organizational development skills across Product, Engineering, Design, and Data/AI teams
  • Pragmatic, hands-on ownership mindset with strong structured communication and the ability to create clarity in complex environments

Preferred

  • Experience with DiGA, digital therapeutics, SaMD, MDR Class I/IIa, ISO/QMS environments, TR-03161, GDPR, or comparable healthcare regulatory frameworks
  • Familiarity with German healthcare workflows, prescription journeys, HCP interaction, reimbursement logic, Gematik/ePA/eVO, or emerging interoperability standards such as EUDI Wallet
  • Experience building data-driven and AI-enabled product capabilities such as personalization, recommendations, automation, analytics, or experimentation platforms
  • Experience working in or with larger enterprise environments while preserving entrepreneurial speed and product focus

How You Will Work

At Cara Care, you work alongside a team of physicians, researchers, developers, product specialists, and people experts who are passionate about improving people’s lives. We are inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We work fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of wellbeing – both for our users and for ourselves.

In this role you will work in a hybrid or remote setup and collaborate closely with leadership, Medical, Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, Privacy, Security, and Bayer stakeholders. The role requires the ability to combine startup-like ownership with the governance expectations of a global healthcare company. Fluency in English is required; German language skills are strongly preferred given Cara Care’s DiGA context and German healthcare ecosystem.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation
You receive fair pay, regular salary payments, and of course the technology you need to do your job really well.

🫶 Great team
You’ll join a lively, interdisciplinary team and a friendly, supportive working atmosphere – including regular on-site team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first
Want to work from home? No problem. Prefer coming to the office in Berlin? Also great. We are remote-first – you work wherever suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off
Rest is important. With us you get 30 days off per year: 26 vacation days plus 4 extra mental health days for breaks when you need them.

🦉 Flexible working hours
Whether you like to start early or prefer a later start – you shape your day in a way that works for you.

🚀 You make a difference
With us, you’re not just part of it – you’re at the center of it. Your ideas matter, and you can truly make an impact.

Diversity matters to us

We believe diverse teams build better products. That’s why we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone – regardless of race, religion, skin color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

Einarbeitung & Entwicklung:  Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie individuelle Coachings, die auf persönliche Stärken abgestimmt sind und die fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung unterstützen. B2B-Kundenkontakt:  Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftskund:innen in einem professionellen und wertschätzenden Umfeld. Arbeitszeiten:  Geregelte Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag (zwischen 09:00 und 18:00 Uhr), keine Wochenend- oder Feiertagsarbeit. Warum Shiftmove? Fahrzeuge auf unserer Plattform bis 2027) – eine seltene Kombination aus Stabilität, Ownership und Geschwindigkeit. International & kollaborativ arbeiten:  Mit über 30 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sind Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Verantwortung fest in unserer Arbeitsweise verankert. Wachsen mit Autonomie und Vertrauen:  Wir investieren gezielt in Produkt, Daten und Menschen – und geben dir den Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen, andere herauszufordern und aktiv mitzugestalten, wie wir skalieren. Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. As a Senior Designer Customisable Furniture, you’ll drive the creative vision for the newest category within our Westwing Collection, bringing innovative design, modular thinking, and strategic product development to life. You’ll play a key role in shaping this category from the ground up, ensuring a seamless blend of style, configurability, quality, and sustainability. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Play a key role in the in-house design team, creating on-trend, visually appealing designs for modular and customisable furniture - the newest category within the Westwing Collection
  • Drive product development with an emphasis on premium design, quality, sustainability, and materials, balancing aesthetics with the manufacturability of configurable systems
  • Translate modular system architecture into detailed CAD specifications, technical drawings, and prototypes, ensuring components work coherently across configurations
  • Collaborate with engineering and tech to ensure the digital customization experience faithfully reflects design intent
  • Bring an innovative, problem-solving mindset to the design challenges unique to a brand-new, still-evolving category
  • Effectively communicate and convey creative visions to both internal and external stakeholders
  • Align creative decisions with assortment strategies and commercial goals


YOU COME WITH

  • 7+ years of professional experience in product design, with proven expertise in furniture design and development, including materials, quality, and sustainability
  • Experience designing modular or configurable product systems, with proficiency in CAD/3D modeling tools (e.g. Rhino, SolidWorks, AutoCAD)
  • In-depth knowledge of industry trends, brands, and IP, coupled with a passion for design
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building processes from scratch as part of a brand-new category
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, able to work closely with engineering, buying, and commercial teams
  • Hands-on attitude and experience in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Fluency in English


WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

  • A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
  • An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
  • A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
  • Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
  • 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
  • A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
  • Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
  • Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
  • Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
  • Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
  • One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
  • Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Movie Nights and Oktoberfest to Summer & Winter Parties


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

title: Regional Sales Manager (m/w/d) - Respiratory - Westdeutschland
description: Bei Breathment startest Du in eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Digital-Health-Start-Ups in Respiratory. Wir entwickeln digitale Versorgungsprogramme für Menschen mit chronischen Atemwegserkrankungen und arbeiten bereits mit führenden Partnern aus Krankenkassen, Pharma, Homecare, Kliniken und Patientenverbänden zusammen. title: Head of Brand & Intellectual Property (m/w/d)
description: InkuPlay bringt ambitionierte Talente, kreative Köpfe und wettbewerbsorientierte Spielerinnen und Spieler zusammen, um eine moderne Esport-, Gaming- und Entertainmentmarke aufzubauen. Wir wollen nicht einfach nur an bestehenden Strukturen teilnehmen. Wir möchten neue Formate entwickeln, Communities verbinden und die Zukunft von Gaming, Esport und digitaler Unterhaltung aktiv mitgestalten. Dabei denken wir mutig, handeln unternehmerisch und bleiben zugleich nahbar, direkt und authentisch. Unsere Mission ist es, durch Wettbewerb, starke Persönlichkeiten und relevante Geschichten echte Emotionen auszulösen. Wir möchten Inhalte und Erlebnisse schaffen, über die Menschen sprechen, die sie teilen und mit denen sie sich identifizieren können – innerhalb des Esports und weit darüber hinaus. Du willst nicht nur bestehende Markenrichtlinien verwalten, sondern eine unverwechselbare Marke von Grund auf mitprägen? Du möchtest eigene Formate, geistiges Eigentum und langfristig nutzbare Markenwelten entwickeln? Dann könnte diese Position genau die richtige Herausforderung für dich sein. Aufgaben Als Head of Brand & Intellectual Property (m/w/d) verantwortest du, wie InkuPlay aussieht, klingt und wahrgenommen wird. Du entwickelst unsere strategische und kreative Markenführung weiter, definierst unsere visuelle und sprachliche Identität und baust eigene Inhalte, Formate und Markenrechte auf, die langfristig skalierbar und wirtschaftlich nutzbar sind. Dabei führst du die Bereiche Creative Direction, Design, Content-Produktion, Intellectual Property, Formate sowie Public Relations und Kommunikation zu einer gemeinsamen Brand Engine zusammen. Die Position ist in Vollzeit zu besetzen und berichtet unmittelbar an die Geschäftsführung beziehungsweise den Chief Operating Officer. Deine Aufgaben Du baust den Bereich Brand & Intellectual Property bei InkuPlay strategisch, organisatorisch und operativ auf und entwickelst ihn kontinuierlich weiter. Du verbindest Creative Direction, Design, Content, Produktion, Postproduktion, eigene Formate, Intellectual Property sowie PR und Kommunikation zu einer einheitlichen Markenorganisation. Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Kreativen, Designerinnen und Designern, Produzentinnen und Produzenten, Content-Verantwortlichen sowie Kommunikations- und PR-Expertinnen und -Experten. Du verantwortest die Markenstrategie, Positionierung sowie die visuelle und sprachliche Identität von InkuPlay über sämtliche Teams, Plattformen, Kanäle und Märkte hinweg. Du übersetzt die strategische Vision von InkuPlay in konkrete Geschichten, Kampagnen, Formate, Markenwelten und wiedererkennbare kreative Systeme. Du entwickelst ein Portfolio eigener, klar InkuPlay zuordenbarer Inhalte und Intellectual Properties – von wiederkehrenden Social-Media- und Videoformaten bis hin zu langfristigen Entertainment-Franchises, Events und Storytelling-Universen. Du entwickelst InkuPlay von einer überwiegend contentproduzierenden Organisation hin zu einem Unternehmen, das eigene Formate, Charaktere, Markenwelten und kommerziell verwertbare Intellectual Properties erschafft. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Inhalte unverwechselbar, konsistent, skalierbar und langfristig wirtschaftlich nutzbar sind. Du verantwortest die gesamte kreative Produktionskette – von Konzeption und Pre-Production über Produktion bis zur Postproduktion und Veröffentlichung. Du etablierst effiziente Produktionsprozesse, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und skalierbare Workflows, ohne dabei die kreative Qualität einzuschränken. Du leitest den Designbereich und entwickelst verbindliche visuelle Systeme, Markenrichtlinien, Templates und Designstandards für digitale, physische und erlebnisorientierte Kontaktpunkte. Du stellst eine konsistente Markenführung über Social Media, Streaming, Websites, Plattformen, Events, Turniere, Merchandise, Sponsoringaktivitäten und interne Kommunikation hinweg sicher. Du verantwortest die PR- und Kommunikationsstrategie von InkuPlay, entwickelst relevante Narrative und positionierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Medien, Partnern, Talenten, Communities und der Öffentlichkeit. Du baust belastbare Medienbeziehungen auf und schützt gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und den zuständigen Fachbereichen die Reputation von InkuPlay. Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Marketing, Partnerships, Media, Esports, Commercial, Community, People & Culture und Legal zusammen. Du stellst sicher, dass die Markenstrategie bei Partnerschaften, Kampagnen, Teamaktivitäten, Spielerkommunikation, Creator-Kooperationen und kommerziellen Projekten von Anfang an berücksichtigt wird. Du entwickelst klare kreative Standards, Freigabeprozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten und Kennzahlen. Du schaffst ein ausgewogenes Verhältnis zwischen hoher kreativer Ambition, effizienter Umsetzung und messbarer Wirkung. Du beobachtest relevante Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Gaming, Esport, Sport, Entertainment, Medien, Popkultur, Social Media und Creator Economy. Du erkennst frühzeitig kulturelle Veränderungen und übersetzt sie in relevante, glaubwürdige und zukunftsfähige Markenaktivitäten für InkuPlay. Du begleitest den Schutz, die Dokumentation und die wirtschaftliche Verwertung unserer Marken, Formate, Designs und sonstigen geistigen Eigentumsrechte in enger Abstimmung mit dem Legal-Team und externen Rechtsberatern. Qualifikation Du verfügst über mindestens sechs Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Brand Management, Creative Direction, Content, Marketing, Media oder Entertainment. Du hast bereits kreative, kommunikative oder produktionsorientierte Teams geführt und weiterentwickelt. Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrung in Markenstrategie, Positionierung, Creative Direction, Storytelling und Content-Produktion. Idealerweise hast du für Unternehmen oder Organisationen aus den Bereichen Entertainment, Gaming, Esport, Sport, Lifestyle, Medien oder Creator Economy gearbeitet. Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, eigenständige Formate, Markenwelten, Content-Franchises oder andere schutz- und skalierbare Intellectual Properties aufzubauen. Du verstehst visuelle Kultur, Designsysteme und kreative Produktionsprozesse über digitale, soziale, physische und erlebnisorientierte Kanäle hinweg. Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für kulturelle Relevanz, starke Geschichten, emotionale Markenführung und moderne Community-Kommunikation. Du kannst strategisch und langfristig denken und bist gleichzeitig in der Lage, Entscheidungen schnell und pragmatisch umzusetzen. Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit PR, Medien, Unternehmenskommunikation und reputationsrelevanten Themen. Du bist in der Lage, klare kreative Leitlinien zu formulieren und unterschiedliche interne sowie externe Stakeholder auf eine gemeinsame Markenvision auszurichten. Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten. Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen, unternehmerisch geprägten und teilweise noch im Aufbau befindlichen Umfeld wohl. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest selbstständig und wartest nicht darauf, dass andere dir jeden nächsten Schritt vorgeben. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind willkommen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Esport, Gaming, Sport oder Entertainment ist ausdrücklich erwünscht, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Benefits Bei InkuPlay erhältst du nicht nur eine bestehende Marke, die verwaltet werden muss. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, eine junge Esport- und Entertainmentorganisation maßgeblich mit aufzubauen und ihre Identität langfristig zu prägen. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit der Geschäftsführung und den zentralen Unternehmensbereichen zusammen. Deine Ideen verschwinden nicht in langen Abstimmungsschleifen, sondern können unmittelbar Einfluss auf unsere Marke, unsere Inhalte, unsere Teams und unsere zukünftige Entwicklung nehmen. Dich erwarten insbesondere: großer Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum, direkter Einfluss auf den Aufbau einer wachsenden Gaming- und Esportmarke, kurze Entscheidungswege, flexible und hybride beziehungsweise remote Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, ein internationales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld, enge Zusammenarbeit mit Esport-Teams, Talenten, Creatorn und Partnern, die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate und Markenwelten von Grund auf aufzubauen, eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit langfristiger Entwicklungsperspektive. Unsere Werte und unsere Zusammenarbeit Wir wollen ein Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem sich Menschen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Identität, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder persönlichem Hintergrund willkommen und respektiert fühlen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Ideen machen uns kreativer, leistungsfähiger und als Organisation stärker. Gleichzeitig sind wir überzeugt, dass Menschen ihre beste Arbeit leisten, wenn ihnen Vertrauen entgegengebracht wird, sie Verantwortung übernehmen dürfen und gemeinsam an einem größeren Ziel arbeiten. One Love. One Family. One Victory. Wir stellen uns Herausforderungen gemeinsam. Niemand wird zurückgelassen. Wir unterstützen einander, sprechen Probleme offen an und feiern Erfolge als Team. Grenzen verschieben Wir akzeptieren den Status quo nicht einfach. Wir denken größer, hinterfragen bestehende Strukturen und suchen auch dann nach Lösungen, wenn etwas zunächst unmöglich erscheint. Verantwortung statt Ausreden Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Entscheidungen, unsere Ergebnisse und unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir warten nicht darauf, dass andere Probleme für uns lösen. Direkt, ehrlich und respektvoll Wir kommunizieren klar und authentisch. Unterschiedliche Meinungen sind willkommen, solange sie respektvoll, sachlich und lösungsorientiert eingebracht werden. Fehler werden zu Fortschritt Nicht jede Idee wird sofort funktionieren. Entscheidend ist, dass wir aus Rückschlägen lernen, Verantwortung übernehmen und uns gemeinsam weiterentwickeln. Trotz aller Ambition bleiben wir menschlich Unsere Arbeit ist wichtig und wir verfolgen große Ziele. Trotzdem verlieren wir nicht die Bodenhaftung. Wir möchten gemeinsam erfolgreich sein, Spaß an unserer Arbeit haben und ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Benefits

Wir stellen uns Herausforderungen gemeinsam. Niemand wird zurückgelassen. Wir unterstützen einander, sprechen Probleme offen an und feiern Erfolge als Team.

Grenzen verschieben

Verantwortung statt Ausreden

Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Entscheidungen, unsere Ergebnisse und unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir warten nicht darauf, dass andere Probleme für uns lösen.

Direkt, ehrlich und respektvoll

Wir kommunizieren klar und authentisch. Unterschiedliche Meinungen sind willkommen, solange sie respektvoll, sachlich und lösungsorientiert eingebracht werden.

Fehler werden zu Fortschritt

Nicht jede Idee wird sofort funktionieren. Entscheidend ist, dass wir aus Rückschlägen lernen, Verantwortung übernehmen und uns gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Trotz aller Ambition bleiben wir menschlich

raw.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.   At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.   Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. Experience with Feature-module architecture in production. Confidence with Git / GitLab , including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD . A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code. Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to Have Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes. Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering. Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler , Perfetto , Baseline Profiles , or similar. Published apps on Google Play you're proud of. An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share. Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules. Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow. Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively. Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors. Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.   Receive unwavering support and care   Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Android Engineer or Tech Lead who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.

If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.


What You’ll Do
  • Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.
  • Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:
  • Multi-account cash flow management
  • Banking transactions and payments
  • Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control
  • AI-powered accounting automation
  • Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose.
  • Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.
  • Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    • Who You Are

    You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

    Your experience includes:

  • Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.
  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID, and Clean Architecture.
  • Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — MVI, MVVM, and MVP — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.
  • Hands-on experience with our core stack:
  • Reactive programming & async: RxJava, Kotlin Coroutines / Flow
  • Dependency injection: Dagger 2, Hilt, or Koin
  • Networking: Retrofit
  • Navigation: Cicerone, Jetpack Navigation Component
  • Modern UI: Jetpack Compose
  • Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
  • Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.
  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.
  • A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Nice to Have
  • Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).
  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.
  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler, Perfetto, Baseline Profiles, or similar.
  • Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.
  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.
  • Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.
  • Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.
  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

    • Recruitment Flow

    • Recruiter Interview
    • First Technical Interview
    • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
    • Mobile System Design Interview
    • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
    • Offer

    What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

and protoflight testing industry standards, and flight hardware handling.</li> <li>Knowledge of spacecraft systems and the interactions between structures, mechanisms, avionics, payloads, and thermal systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of structural dynamics and vibration theory (resonance and modal behavior, wave propagation, random vibration, boundary control, etc.).</li> <li>Knowledge of heat transfer principles and thermal management technology.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to evaluate test data, identify anomalies, assess risk, make sound engineering decisions during off-nominal situations, and develop recovery plans for flight hardware.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Solidworks CAD &amp; Gesucht wird ein Bilanzbuchhalter, welcher Erfahrung in der Kosolidierung aufweist.

Die Unternehmung ist mit ihrer Verwaltung in sehr guter Lage im Kölner Zentrum angesiedelt. Hier bekommen Sie die Gelegenheit, eine spannende Position in der Bilanzbuchhaltung zu übernehmen mit Perspektive auf einen erweiterten Verantwortungsbereich in Richtung kaufmännische Leitung in ca. 1-2 Jahren, sofern angestrebt.

Werden Sie Teil des Erfolgsunternehmens und profitieren Sie von spannenden und interessanten Aufgaben in einem attraktiven Umfeld.
Zudem erwartet Sie ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz bei einem sehr gut aufgestelltem, Inhabergeführtem Unternehmen, bei welcher sich die Work-Life Balance, als auch gute Aufstiegs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten ausgewogen ausgleichen und die Hand geben.

Sprechen Sie uns gerne an, wir stellen Ihnen auf Anfrage gerne weitere Details zu unserem A-Partner vor.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen der Muttergesellschaft
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen der Muttergesellschaft
  • Erstellung des Konzernabschlusses gemäß HGB
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung der Jahresgeschäftsberichte
  • Zuständigkeit für unterschiedliche Projektaufgaben im Finance-Bereich
  • Koordination von nationalen und internationalen Gesellschaften und Vorgabe der einheitlichen Konzernprozesse

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes BWL-Studium mit dem Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder durch abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter*in (m/w/d)
  • Berufserfahrung im Controlling, Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder einer vergleichbaren Position in einem Konzern, einer Gruppe oder einem Unternehmen mit mehreren Standorten
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie strukturiertes Denkvermögen und hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit

Benefits

  • Die betriebliche Unterstützung, sich zum absoluten Fachspezialisten zu entwickeln
  • Alternativ, die innerbetriebliche Möglichkeit in Richtung Führungskraft vor zu stoßen
  • Die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzubilden bei voller Kostenübernahme
  • Vielfältige Sozialleistungen, Zuschuss zur bAV (Betriebsrente) und eine kostenfreie Gruppenunfallversicherung

Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! NOCH FRAGEN? Silja freut sich auf deine Nachricht und hilft dir gerne weiter! ÜBER UNS  Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltages verbringen - in Büros im Gewerbegebiet, wo es weit und breit nichts zu Essen gibt, in einer langen Schicht im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Du findest uns auch in der Uni, am Flughafen und im Hotel und überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Durch unsere eigens entwickelte Technologieplattform optimieren wir unsere Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt haben - auf die Umwelt, auf den täglichen Alltag unserer Kunden und auf unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir Gerichte, die übrig bleiben, an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir täglich mit Foodji bereits Tausende Menschen deutschlandweit. Zu unseren Kunden zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal oder Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns! Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Senior Technical SEO Manager to join our Marketing team in the Madrid Office. This position ensures the technical SEO integrity of our multilingual community commerce platform across nine international markets - like mydealz.de , hotukdeals, and more. It combines classic Technical SEO with solid AI, data, and automation skills to ensure that indexing, category, and reporting workflows are scalable and not manual. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph. raw.title: Senior Technical SEO Manager (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical SEO Manager to join our Marketing team in the Madrid Office. This position ensures the technical SEO integrity of our multilingual community commerce platform across nine international markets - like mydealz.de, hotukdeals, and more. It combines classic Technical SEO with solid AI, data, and automation skills to ensure that indexing, category, and reporting workflows are scalable and not manual.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct technical audits, crawl/log-file analyses, and manage indexation (noindex, canonicals, robots.txt) to resolve issues on a platform with large URL volumes.
  • Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph.
  • Drive the technical readiness of the platform for generative search engines (GEO) and AI-powered answers (AIO), including managing AI crawlers.
  • Build and automate internal tools, apps, and monitoring workflows using an AI-first approach with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, Cursor, and n8n.
  • Establish workflows to measure and analyze our visibility within AI answers and translate SEO goals into actionable technical requirements for Product & Tech teams.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with deep experience in technical SEO for large-scale websites, who has a proven ability to leverage AI and automation to create scalable systems.

  • Proven experience working with Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs/SISTRIX/SEMrush; HTML/CSS, JS rendering, Schema.org;
  • Deep understanding of entity-based search and Knowledge Graphs; AI-first building with LLMs (Claude, Lovable, etc.).
  • Nice to have: Dashboarding, database experience, programmatic SEO, and experience building agent/tooling infrastructures (n8n).
  • Experience isolating platform-wide patterns and algorithmic anomalies across all markets, distinguishing business impact from digital noise.
  • Systematically dissects root causes when algorithms change, finding creative workarounds where standard tools reach their limits.
  • Experience translating highly complex technical SEO dependencies into clear business value for Product Owners and developers.
  • Independently identifies and prioritizes high-impact actions and documents workflows to ensure team resilience.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and spoken in English; any other language is a plus

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

title: Courier HR Senior Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.</p> <p>The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.</p> <p>As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.</p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <p><strong>Employee lifecycle execution at scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).</li> <li>Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.</li> <li>Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.</li> <li>Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.</li> <li>Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and SOP creation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.</li> <li>Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.</li> <li>Partner with the Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.</li> <li>Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.</li> <li>Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.</li> <li>Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.</li> <li>A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.</li> <li>High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.</li> <li>Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.</li> <li>Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.</li> <li>Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.</p> <p>If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September.</strong></p> <p><strong>Additional benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Health insurance</li> <li>A sport benefit (PassSport)</li> <li>A tax-free commuter benefit</li> <li>A monthly lunch benefit</li> <li>Wolt Credits Cashback program</li> <li>Access to the Employee Assistance Program (free, confidential mental health support) and the Cuckoo wellness app</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p><strong>Please submit your application and resume in English.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The hiring process includes conversations with the talent acquisition partner, hiring managers and a practical assignment with a final cross-functional discussion.</p> <p>If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of a motivated team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Recruiter (f/m/d) Remote Germany
raw.description:
The role in brief

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.

Why this role exists

selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.

We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.

This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.

What you will work on

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract

  • Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles

  • Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search

  • Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality

  • Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage

  • Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure

  • Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards


Must-haves

  • Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer

  • Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently

  • Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS

  • Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions

  • KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain

  • German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages

  • Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment

  • Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination

  • Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee

  • Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles

How we work

selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.

Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.

There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.

Working conditions

Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin

Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows

Contract: Permanent employment

Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

Salary: Discussed transparently in the first conversation

Start: As soon as possible

Holiday: 30 days plus public holidays in your federal state

How to apply

Apply with your CV. No formal cover letter required.

If you have relevant work samples, for example Boolean search strings, sourcing strategies, anonymised KPI dashboards, or process documentation, feel free to include them. They are welcome but not mandatory.

Our hiring process:

  1. 30-minute introduction call

  2. Skills interview in German, including a short live sourcing exercise

  3. Practical take-home personality test focused on your thinking logic and approach

  4. Final conversation with peers and Management, followed by offer discussion

We give clear, timely feedback at every stage.

Before you apply

If you match most of the profile but not every point, we would still welcome a conversation. The requirements above describe what matters for the role, not a checklist for perfection.

Equal opportunity and data protection

selectry GmbH is committed to equal opportunity. We hire for skill and potential. Applications are welcome regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or family status. Accessible process steps are available on request.

Your application data is processed exclusively for the purpose of this recruitment process in accordance with the GDPR. If you would like your data corrected or deleted, contact .

Ab sofort / Vollzeit / Österreich Süd (Wien, Niederösterreich, Burgenland, Steiermark, Kärnten) 
 
Energiezukunft verkaufen, statt alte Lösungen verwalten?  
In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Akquisition und Planung von Gewerbeprojekten und berätst Gewerbekunden zu innovativen Lösungen rund um Photovoltaik, Speicher, Ladeinfrastruktur und Energiemanagement. Dabei verantwortest du den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der ersten Kundenanfrage bis zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss – und trägst maßgeblich zum Vertriebserfolg von neoom bei.


Deine Rolle im Team

  • Du verantwortest den Vertriebserfolg und Umsatz in deinem Vertriebsgebiet und baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen im Gewerbe- und Industriesegment auf.
  • Du akquirierst aktiv neue Projekte und berätst Kund:innen zu unserem Energie- und Softwareportfolio von PV-Anlagen, Speichern und Ladeinfrastruktur bis hin zu neoom AI und der neoom APP.
  • Du entwickelst individuelle Energiekonzepte und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die optimal auf die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen abgestimmt sind.
  • Du erstellst Angebote, begleitest Vertragsverhandlungen und führst Projekte bis zum erfolgreichen Verkaufsabschluss.
  • Du erkennst Marktpotenziale, identifizierst neue Vertriebschancen und koordinierst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit internen Teams und unseren Partnern.


Dein Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung (mit Schwerpunkt Elektrotechnik, Energiewirtschaft, erneuerbare Energien)
  • Branchenkenntnisse im Bereich Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher, Ladeinfrastruktur und Energiemanagemensysteme
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebietes und zwischen den Büros in Freistadt und Wien
  • Selbstständige, analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Kommunikationsstärke, überzeugendes Auftreten im Kundenkontakt
  • Starkes Interesse an der persönlichen und „digitalen“ Betreuung von Kunden, Freude und Passion für die erneuerbare Energieerzeugung- und Speicherung und E-Mobilität


Das erwartet dich

  • Ein eigenes E-Firmenfahrzeug auch zur privaten Nutzung in deiner Freizeit. 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Homeoffice ermöglichen eine bedarfsorientierte Gestaltung deines Arbeitstages im Rahmen der betrieblichen Abläufe.
  • Eine Rolle mit hoher Reisetätigkeit und viel persönlichem Austausch mit Kunden vor Ort 
  • Für deine mehrjährige Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du extra Urlaubstage.
  • Mit unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm profitierst du direkt vom gemeinsamen Unternehmenserfolg.
  • Förderung der laufenden beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung im Unternehmen.
  • Möglichkeit der aktiven Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung eigener Ideen in einem Unternehmen.
  • Ein motiviertes und dynamisches Team, das mit Leidenschaft unsere Mission verfolgt, sowie eine familiäre "Du-Kultur" ab dem ersten Kennenlernen.
Du, deine Erfahrung und dein Mehrwert für neoom sind einmalig. Laut Gesetz ist eine Gehaltsangabe notwendig (ca. € 4.000,- brutto pro Monat für 38,5 Wochenstunden). Es ist selbstverständlich, dass wir über deine individuelle Bezahlung persönlich – als Teil einer guten, beruflichen Partnerschaft - sprechen. 

Uns ist wichtig, was du kannst, dein Geschlecht ist uns egal.


Deine Ansprechperson


Lisi MAYER
Head of People & Culture
INFINITE
POWER FOR ALL
OF US
neoom.com, Freistadt | Wien | Nürnberg | Rotkreuz
