title: Commercial Services - UK Country Commercial (Senior Manager / Lead)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2>About the team&nbsp;</h2> <p>The Commercial Services team is responsible for enabling our members to access Tide tools which allow them to both sell to their customers but also to buy effectively and save time and money. Our aim is to make their commerce and customer management seamless, and manageable fully via Tide. We work closely with Product, BI, CRM, Sales, and Operations teams to translate member and market insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, go-to-market strategies, and campaigns that enhance engagement and retention. We also develop and lead the GTMs for our website builder ‘Own Website’, eCommerce store ‘Own Website Plus’, a new Tide Online Network and customer lead generation and management, besides partner offers to give our members even more value and a suite of customer management tools, with an ambitious roadmap for the next 2 years to extend this offering even further.&nbsp; As a high-impact team, we move quickly from ideation to execution, learning and iterating throughout the process.</p> <h2>About the role&nbsp;</h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Commercial Lead to lead Tide’s Commercial Services growth in the UK.&nbsp; You will sit at the heart of Marketing, Product and Performance, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand performance, uncover opportunities, and work across areas to deliver.<br><br>In this role, you will also be responsible for owning the full Go-To-Market approach, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered.&nbsp; This included the end-to-end in-app journeys, as well as the full suite of CRM, Acquisition and OBTM marketing.&nbsp; You’ll need to partner super effectively with both product and marketing teams to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential. And you’ll be the go to person for any performance and commercial questions.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership &amp; Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for products, ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure campaign performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product positioning and communications.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner <br>with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity.&nbsp; This will include shaping product positioning, aligning on roadmaps and supporting&nbsp; successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Go-To-Market Strategy</strong>: &nbsp; You’ll lead Go-To-Markets across channels, partnering with excellent sales, operations and CRM marketing teams to deliver best-in-class marketing.&nbsp; You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans. You’ll be the enabler for many and guardian of the plan and hold others to account for delivery<br><br></li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management: </strong>&nbsp;As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders.&nbsp; This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Market &amp; Competitor Intelligence</strong>: Lead ongoing market research and competitive analysis to monitor trends, and benchmark to translate it into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>7+ years’ product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, B2B2C, Lead generation, fintech or adjacent industries—ideally with subscription-based or tiered pricing products.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen:&nbsp; Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.&nbsp; Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.</li> <li>Strong analytical mindset: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.</li> <li>Proven track record of successful Go-To-Market – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns&nbsp; (across sales, CRM marketing, in-app contact points)</li> <li>Exceptional project management skills, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.</li> <li>Self-starter attitude: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll get in return:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&amp;D budget</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide&nbsp;</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangement</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">Landor is looking for a Senior Motion Designer to join our London studio. Could this be you? </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>We are Landor, part of WPP<br><br>World-leading brand experts,&nbsp;<br>underpinned by the most expansive strategic &amp; creative capabilities in our category.<br><br>We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.<br><br>We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.&nbsp;<br><br>Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace &amp; architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).<br><br></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.wpp.com/en"><u>WPP.com</u></a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"> </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What you’ll do</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>As a&nbsp;Senior 3D Motion Designer, you’ll be our resident 3D specialist, driving intelligent and refreshingly different motion design across all brands within Landor. You will be responsible for bringing brand systems to life through high-impact visual effects, particle physics, and photorealistic 3D animation—swinging effortlessly from client work to high-stakes pitches. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>About the Role</strong></strong></p> <p>A fast-paced, global business with significant growth ambitions, and an Accounting function entering a period of transformation to support that growth. This is an exciting opportunity to drive that agenda, with full ownership of the numbers and the scope to shape what comes next for the function.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP, Controllership and working in a leadership team alongside Reporting, Risk, and Payroll, the Director, Accounting holds full accountability for the completeness and accuracy of the Global General Ledger across the full P&amp;L and Balance Sheet. This role will lead a team of accounting professionals and drive an improvement agenda that scales the function to meet the demands of a fast-paced business — through hands-on ownership of the numbers, critical thinking on every estimate and judgement, and continued development of the function beyond process compliance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Own the Global General Ledger &amp; Financial Close</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Ultimate accountability for the Global GL under US GAAP, including the completeness, accuracy, and timely close of all entities worldwide</li> <li>Build and lead a scalable end-to-end close operating model; set standards, drive consistency, and coach the team to execute with rigour</li> <li>Maintain the quality of balance sheet reconciliations and close deliverables; identify and resolve issues in a timely manner, applying critical evaluation alongside sound accounting and commercial judgement</li> <li>Estimates, accruals, and accounting positions that accurately reflect the pace and trajectory of the business, with the accounting telling the true story behind the numbers</li> <li>Deliver authoritative monthly and quarterly P&amp;L and balance sheet flux analysis — clear on commercial and accounting drivers, risks and opportunities, and material one-off items&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Apply and Uphold Technical Accounting Standards</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>The senior escalation point for accounting matters across the business; research, document, and defend positions on complex and novel issues</li> <li>Provide technical accounting support to business growth and commercial deals, including under ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition) and other judgement-intensive areas</li> <li>Ground accounting in US GAAP principles and policies, with technical rigour as the baseline</li> <li>Evaluate the accounting treatment of commercial arrangements with technical precision and commercial awareness</li> <li>Critical thinking on every judgement call, with standard methodology as a starting point rather than a substitute for judgement&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Drive Continuous Improvement</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the improvement agenda — simplify, standardise, and automate close processes, leading with the adoption of AI and enabling technology</li> <li>Partner across Finance, Enterprise Systems and AI Enablement on systems transformation that scales the function for the future</li> <li>Define and embed quality standards, governance frameworks, and documentation requirements across a geographically dispersed team</li> <li>Partner with Finance Operations and the Center of Excellence to maintain clear ownership and consistent execution across time zones (US West Coast, US East Coast, UK, India).&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Lead &amp; Develop the Team</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and develop a team of accounting professionals, building technical capability and succession depth within the function</li> <li>Create a high-performing team culture grounded in clear expectations, mutual accountability, meaningful development, and direct, honest communication</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Across the Organisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with Finance and Commercial business partners; bring commercial perspective to accounting judgements</li> <li>&nbsp; Represent the Accounting function with confidence and credibility at senior management level&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Experience &amp; Qualifications</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Fully-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent)</li> <li>Significant post-qualification experience in financial accounting leadership, with full GL accountability and ownership of the end-to-end close cycle across a complex, multi-entity, global business — including the completeness and accuracy of the numbers</li> <li>Proven track record of leading and developing teams of qualified accountants and people managers&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Skills &amp; Ways of Working</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep technical grounding in US GAAP, with the confidence to take and defend positions on complex matters</li> <li>Numbers-first with strong ownership of accuracy — credible at senior stakeholder level, telling the story behind the numbers and comfortable pushing back when warranted</li> <li>A natural change leader with an improvement mindset — builds the case, brings the team along, and delivers lasting change at pace</li> <li>A high-performing people leader, invested in growth and outcomes</li> <li>At ease in fast-paced, global complexity, fluent across both strategic and detailed work</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being: <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on your career growth: <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership development</li> <li>Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings</li> </ul> </li> <li>Travel Discounts</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> <li>20 days of paid time off</li> <li>Private health and dental insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> </ul> <p>We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.</p> <p>The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.</p> <p><strong><strong>Work Environment &amp; Flexibility</strong></strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</p> <p><strong><strong>Inclusion</strong></strong></p> <p>We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">#LI-LT1 #LI-Hybrid<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring | UK | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u>.</p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h3></h3> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3>Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring</h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates <a href="https://grafana.com/products/cloud/synthetic-monitoring/">Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring</a>, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.</p> <p>Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.</p> <p>The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.</p> <p>The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own features end-to-end across the stack</strong>: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React</li> <li><strong>Design and evolve systems, not just features</strong>: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales</li> <li><strong>Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows</strong> that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform</li> <li><strong>Make the product operable at enterprise scale</strong>: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence</li> <li><strong>Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables</strong> and iterate quickly based on feedback</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation</strong>: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature</li> <li><strong>Be a part of the team's on-call rotation</strong> and take ownership of the services you're running</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies you'll work with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)</li> <li>TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)</li> <li>Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure</li> <li>k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)</li> <li>Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are <strong>comfortable working in a remote-first company</strong>; communication is key.</li> <li>For us, working together means being <strong>collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful</strong>. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.</li> <li><strong>Strong Go, or a path to it.</strong> We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.</li> <li><strong>Operational mindset.</strong> You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.</li> <li>You are a <strong>systems thinker</strong>: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism and short feedback loops.</strong> You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>a software development process that takes a user-centered approach</strong>. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.</li> <li>You use <strong>AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow</strong> - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale</li> <li>Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment</li> <li>Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale</li> <li>Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <div class="content-conclusion"> <div> <p class="p1">In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 72<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span> - GBP 90<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span>.&nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed <a href="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs"><span class="s1">here</span></a>.</p> <p class="p1"><em>*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process</em></p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Specifically, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own features end-to-end across the stack</strong>: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React</li> <li><strong>Design and evolve systems, not just features</strong>: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales</li> <li><strong>Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows</strong> that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform</li> <li><strong>Make the product operable at enterprise scale</strong>: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence</li> <li><strong>Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables</strong> and iterate quickly based on feedback</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation</strong>: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature</li> <li><strong>Be a part of the team's on-call rotation</strong> and take ownership of the services you're running</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies you'll work with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)</li> <li>TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)</li> <li>Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure</li> <li>k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)</li> <li>Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are <strong>comfortable working in a remote-first company</strong>; communication is key.</li> <li>For us, working together means being <strong>collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful</strong>. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.</li> <li><strong>Strong Go, or a path to it.</strong> We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.</li> <li><strong>Operational mindset.</strong> You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.</li> <li>You are a <strong>systems thinker</strong>: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism and short feedback loops.</strong> You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>a software development process that takes a user-centered approach</strong>. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.</li> <li>You use <strong>AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow</strong> - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale</li> <li>Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment</li> <li>Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale</li> <li>Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <div class="content-conclusion"> <div> <p class="p1">In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 76<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span> - EUR 95<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span>.&nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process</em></p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. Senior Brand Marketing Executive 

Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office (Tuesday - Thursday)

The Role 

Working within the brand marketing team across Virgin Bet, the Senior Brand Marketing Executive will support the Senior Brand Marketing Manager in planning and executing brand strategies within the markets.

The role will be split across six core areas: 

  • Brand development and guardianship
  • Communications, campaign and media planning
  • Creative development and delivery
  • Co-ordination and execution of sponsorship portfolio
  • Co-ordination and execution of PR and brand
  • Marketing effectiveness measurement 

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition.

As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

Key Responsibilities  

  • Supporting the media planning and delivery of any media deals (in conjunction with the agency)
  • Playing a key role in shaping the creative output of the brand by leading briefing and delivery with internal design teams and external agencies. 
  • Lead the planning and delivery of sponsorship inventory, marketing collateral, and related event-led brand activations with racecourses across the UK.
  • Playing a key role in developing and implementing best-in-class research and measurement frameworks to evaluate brand performance, marketing effectiveness, earned media, sponsorship evaluation and inform strategic decision-making
  • Regularly monitoring and analysing and reporting on marketing performance metrics, including ROI, KPIs, and campaign effectiveness, to assess the success of brand initiatives and identify areas for improvement
  • Taking ownership of updating the master brand budget and associated financial trackers
  • Cultivating and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, including external partners, agencies, and vendors, to support brand initiatives and drive collaborative opportunities
  • Serving as a key point of contact internally and externally for all brand marketing-related activities, providing expert guidance and support to stakeholders at all levels 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Experience within a similar brand/marketing role (client side or agency)
  • Experience/knowledge of the sports betting industry would be advantageous
  • Experienced in managing agencies and working closely with / leading internal teams
  • An effective communicator, well versed in stakeholder management
  • Demonstratable experience of campaign planning and project management
  • Creative experience, working across design based projects
  • Broad channel experience (both media and creative)
  • Strong commercial acumen 

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Eucalyptus</h3> <p>We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. This is a high-trust, high-impact role where the stakes, and the pace, are high.</p> <p data-start="879" data-end="1035">While this role is DE and Expansion market focused today, it has clear runway to grow into a broader European leadership role as we expand across new markets and business lines.</p> <h2 data-start="1042" data-end="1079"><strong data-start="1045" data-end="1079">What You’ll Be Responsible For</strong></h2> <ul> <li data-start="1083" data-end="1266"><strong data-start="1083" data-end="1113">Own the Germany and AMEA Expansion Market financial model</strong> — Build and manage end-to-end models for revenue, CAC, LTV, margin, and free cash flow. Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-start="2258" data-end="2381"><strong data-start="2258" data-end="2291">6+ years in strategic finance</strong>, FP&amp;A, consulting, or banking, with experience in high-growth or tech-enabled businesses.</li> <li data-start="2384" data-end="2521">Proven experience owning <strong data-start="2409" data-end="2450">P&amp;L and end-to-end planning processes</strong> — ideally in a business with both consumer and operational complexity.</li> <li data-start="2524" data-end="2633">Deep understanding of <strong data-start="2546" data-end="2587">CAC, LTV, payback, cash flow dynamics</strong>, and how these fuel long-term value creation.</li> <li data-start="2636" data-end="2742">Highly proficient in <strong data-start="2657" data-end="2682">Google Sheets / Excel</strong> (bonus points for SQL, Looker, NetSuite, or similar tools).</li> <li data-start="2745" data-end="2869">Strong commercial instincts — you're as comfortable in the numbers as you are helping teams make smart, trade-off decisions.</li> </ul> <h3 data-start="2871" data-end="2901"><strong data-start="2875" data-end="2901">Behaviours &amp; Attitudes</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-start="2905" data-end="2980">You <strong data-start="2909" data-end="2922">move fast</strong> and bias toward action, even without perfect information.</li> <li data-start="2983" data-end="3064">You bring a <strong data-start="2995" data-end="3019">strong point of view</strong>, but you’re open to challenge and new ideas.</li> <li data-start="3067" data-end="3159">You get energy from <strong data-start="3087" data-end="3114">messy, complex problems</strong> and know how to bring structure and clarity.</li> <li data-start="3162" data-end="3252">You <strong data-start="3166" data-end="3182">own outcomes</strong>, not just analysis — you want to see your insights drive performance.</li> <li data-start="3255" data-end="3344">You’re calm under pressure, confident with ambiguity, and committed to delivering impact.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why join Eucalyptus?</strong></h3> <p>Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (<a href="https://pilot.com.au/">Pilot,</a>&nbsp;<a href="http://www.kinfertility.com.au/">Kin</a>,&nbsp;<a href="http://skin.software/">Software</a>) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>What’s next</strong> - Our goal for the next three years is to support <strong>1 million patients globally</strong> to live better for longer. class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide white papers.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team and support the company's global sales organisation. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed.</p> <p>The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests.</p> <p>This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions.</li> <li>Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs.</li> <li>Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes.</li> <li>Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required.</li> <li>Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays.</li> <li>Support the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks and legal processes, and develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote best practices and understanding of legal risks, contracting principles and company processes.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture.</li> </ul> <h4>What You’ll Bring</h4> <ul> <li>Qualified lawyer with significant (10-15+ years) post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department but including significant in-house experience.</li> <li>Strong commercial contracts background, ideally within a software, SaaS, cloud technology or broader technology company.</li> <li>Excellent drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.</li> <li>Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner.</li> <li>Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk proportionately. Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive discussions to achieve the best outcome for the business.</li> <li>Proactive, self-motivated and willing to take ownership of complex matters from start to finish.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of matters and conflicting priorities.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts, articulate recommendations and options, and deliver practical advice that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the confidence to make risk-based decisions in situations where there may not be a clear precedent or established playbook.</li> </ul> <div class="content-pay-transparency"> <div title: (Senior) CRM / Lifecycle Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Retention entscheidet, ob aus dem ersten Kauf eine Beziehung über das ganze Hunde- und Katzenleben wird und genau dieses Spielfeld gehört Dir. Du bekommst Ownership über Lifecycle CRM bei 7 starken Petfood-Marken : Du verantwortest unsere Automations und Kampagnen von der Idee bis zum Go-Live - mit modernen Tools, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Impact. Du arbeitest selbstständig, triffst Entscheidungen und verbesserst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Du baust, betreust und optimierst Klaviyo-Flows und -Kampagnen für alle 7 Marken parallel (u.a. Wolfsblut, Herrmann's Manufaktur, pets Premium) - vom Welcome Flow bis zur Reaktivierung. Du verantwortest E-Mail als Kernkanal . Weitere Kanäle wie Print-Mailings, WhatsApp, SMS und RCS bauen wir perspektivisch aus - hier bringst Du kanalübergreifendes Denken ein. Du bringst Maßnahmen eigenständig live und iterierst auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Geschwindigkeit vor Perfektion : Du testest, misst und schärfst schnell nach. Du machst aus Daten konkrete Maßnahmen: RFM, Segmente, Produkt- und Engagement-Daten, Tierprofile, Predictions (Rebuy, CLV, Churn) werden bei Dir zu personalisierter, relevanter Ansprache. Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt. Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen. Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe. Was Du mitbringst Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing mit messbaren Ergebnissen , idealerweise im E-Commerce/D2C. Sehr gute praktische Klaviyo-Kenntnisse (oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Plattform). Du denkst in Customer Journeys und verstehst Retention-Mechaniken (Rebuy, CLV, Churn). AI-native Arbeiten ist für Dich selbstverständlich : Du setzt LLMs, n8n, Cursor und ähnliche Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein. Du baust selbst : Flows, Segmente und Templates entstehen in Deinen Händen. Du bringst sie eigenständig live, lernst aus Ergebnissen und iterierst schnell. Segmentierung, Trigger, A/B-Tests und Deliverability beherrschst Du sicher. Mit Consent und Datenschutz (DSGVO) gehst Du selbstverständlich sauber und verantwortungsvoll um. Du bist datengetrieben und übersetzt unsere Looker-Dashboards in konkrete Maßnahmen. Kreatives Gespür: Du setzt ein Briefing aus dem Nichts auf und bringst eine Kampagne mit einer starken Hookline auf den Punkt. Du verstehst den Zusammenhang zwischen Creative und Performance. Kategorie-Empathie für Copy und Creative : Du kannst Dich in die Perspektive von Tierhalter:innen hineinversetzen - und das zeigt sich in Deiner Ansprache. Was wir Dir bieten Verantwortungsvolle, spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen Unternehmen , das flache Hierarchien und eine offene, lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre lebt, in der alle per "Du" sind Ein freundliches, offenes Team bestehend aus ca. 280 Mitarbeitenden in München, Leipzig und Albourne (UK) mit mehreren lieben Bürohunden an unseren Standorten Flexible Arbeitszeiten (die auf Vertrauensarbeitszeit basieren), Home-Office Optionen inkl. Kostenbeteiligung an Deiner Home-Office Ausstattung und die Möglichkeit, für mehrere Monate aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten 28 Tage Urlaubsanspruc h sowie die Möglichkeit, bis zu 20 Tage unbezahlten Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub zu nehmen! Verschiedene interne & externe Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten , die Du eigenständig nach Deinen Interessen auswählen kannst Deine mentale Gesundheit ist uns wichtig! Deshalb kannst Du im Rahmen der Plattform " OpenUp " anonym an Einzel- oder Gruppentherapie-Sitzungen teilnehmen oder in 1:1 Meetings mit echten Therapeuten sprechen Verschiedene Mitarbeiterrabatte - für Mensch und Tier! Regelmäßige Team-, Company- und Family & Friends- Events Du brauchst eine Pause? Entspanne Dich in unserer Social-Area , die mit einem Kicker ausgestattet ist oder fordere Deine Kollegen auf unserer gemütlichen Sofalandschaft zu einem Mario Kart-Battle (oder einem anderen Nintendo Switch Spiel) heraus! Aufgewärmtes Essen magst Du nicht? Essen bestellen dauert Dir zu lange? In unserem Büro steht Dir eine hochwertige, vollausgestattete Küche zur Verfügung in der Du den Kochlöffel schwingen oder tolle Kuchen zaubern kannst! Kaffee, Kakao, Tee und weitere kühle Softdrinks wie Wasser und Säfte sowie frisches Obst, kleinere Snacks und eine prall gefüllte Süßigkeiten-Schublade stehen Dir kostenlos zur Verfügung EGYM Wellpass Mitgliedschaft: Mit unserer bezuschussten Mitgliedschaft beim EGYM Wellpass erhältst Du Zugang zu tausenden Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen – darunter Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbäder, Kletterhallen, Yoga- und Pilatesstudios sowie viele weitere Angebote. So kannst Du flexibel und deutschlandweit etwas für Deine Fitness und Dein Wohlbefinden tun – ganz so, wie es am besten in Deinen Alltag passt! Zugang zu modernen KI-Tools: Wir stellen Dir moderne KI-Tools zur Verfügung, die Dich dabei unterstützen, effizienter zu arbeiten, neue Ideen zu entwickeln und Deine Fähigkeiten in einer sich stetig wandelnden digitalen Welt weiter auszubauen. Viele weitere, großartige Benefits die wir Dir gerne im Rahmen des Recruitingprozesses näher vorstellen! Interesse ? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit ​Lebenslauf und Anschreiben inkl. title: Partner Solutions Architect (Pan-EMEA GSI)
description: <p>We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The technical solutions team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog’s Director of Partner Solutions Architects, and is aligned to our Channels &amp; Alliances business segment. The PSA is responsible for supporting a variety of technical initiatives and activities for our partners (for example: cloud migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation). They are accountable for the outcome of these initiatives, and frequently collaborate with both Datadog and Partner resources to drive success. raw.description:
Werde Teil von PartSpace und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Bauteilbeschaffung!

PartSpace ist ein wachstumsstarkes, innovatives Tech-Unternehmen mit einer klaren Mission: Mit Künstlicher Intelligenz und echten Engineering-Daten definiert PartSpace den technischen Einkauf der Zukunft neu. Unsere cloudbasierte Plattform macht die Beschaffung von Bauteilen in der Industrie intelligenter - und agiert dabei wie ein Ingenieur.

Wir haben Großes vor: Dafür suchen wir ambitionierte Talente, die nicht nur mitdenken, sondern mitgestalten wollen. Bei uns bekommst du Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag und ein Team, das Technologie mit Haltung verbindet.

Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur Gestaltungsfreiraum und Mitspracherecht - du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das täglich mit Leidenschaft daran arbeitet, unsere KI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln und die industrielle Beschaffung nachhaltig zu verändern - und das ist unser Anspruch. Wir suchen Dich als Enterprise Account Executive (m/w/d) für unsere Kunden aus der Fertigungsindustrie / Manufacturing, um unser Wachstum in diesem Segment weiter voranzutreiben. In einem flexiblen Remote-Setup gestaltest du diesen Weg aktiv mit.

Lust, mit uns die Industrie effizienter zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen!


Das erwartet Dich

Strategische Marktentwicklung & Account Strategy
Du gestaltest die Go-to-Market-Strategie für den Manufacturing-Sektor aktiv mit, wählst deine Zielkunden gezielt nach Marktpotenzial und Eintrittsbarrieren aus und baust dir eine schlagkräftige Pipeline auf. So positionierst du PartSpace als unverzichtbaren Partner für Engineering-, Einkaufs- und Cost-Engineering-Teams.

Prospecting, Sales Cycle & Closing
Du gehst als echter Hunter offensiv über Kaltakquise, Netzwerk und Branchenevents auf neue Kunden zu und steuerst komplexe Enterprise-Deals zielsicher bis zum Abschluss.

Solution Selling & Pain-Point-Discovery
Du gehst in Discovery-Gesprächen mit Engineering-, Einkaufs- und Operations-Verantwortlichen in die Tiefe, spürst die Pain Points auf und verwandelst sie in schlagkräftige, wertbasierte Lösungsvorschläge, die auch auf C-Level und in hierarchisch geprägten Organisationen überzeugen.

Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kunden
Du baust aus jedem gewonnenen Kunden eine langfristige Partnerschaft, treibst Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Expansion-Potenziale aktiv voran und lässt keine Chance auf zusätzliches Wachstum liegen.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Du vernetzt dich eng mit Sales Leadership, SDRs, Marketing sowie Produkt- und Customer-Success-Teams und bündelst diese Kräfte zu einer schlagkräftigen Marktbearbeitung.

Revenue Ownership & Forecasting
Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für deine Umsatzziele und treibst das Wachstum im Manufacturing-Segment maßgeblich voran. Mit einer strukturierten Sales-Methodik (MEDDICC) behältst du deine Opportunities im Griff und sorgst für ein glasklares Forecasting und Pipeline-Management in unserem CRM. 


Das macht Dich aus

  • Du hast ein Studium im Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder BWL, alternativ eine vergleichbar überzeugende Praxiserfahrung
  • Du hast eine beeindruckende Erfolgsbilanz im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb mit signifikanter Umsatzverantwortung und dem Abschluss komplexer Enterprise-Deals
  • Du verstehst Engineering-, Beschaffungs- und Cost-Engineering-Prozesse im Detail und sprichst die Sprache technischer Ansprechpartner
  • Du kennst dich in der Zusammenarbeit mit OEMs sowie Tier-1-Zulieferern bestens aus
  • Du navigierst souverän durch komplexe, hierarchisch geprägte Organisationen und gewinnst selbst die härtesten Entscheider
  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Frameworks wie MEDDICC mit
  • Du bist ehrgeizig, hartnäckig und wettbewerbsstark
  • Du überzeugst auf jeder Entscheiderebene mit starker Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke

description: <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you'll raise the bar for how AI gets built, governed, and evaluated across the team. You'll define standards that other engineers adopt, such as evaluation methodologies for agents and MLOps practices, while acting as the senior technical voice for the most sensitive AI decisions our clients face.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define standards for responsible AI, model governance, and production MLOps that get adopted broadly across the Global Public Sector team</li> <li>Build or validate the highest-risk parts of strategic AI systems and use those systems to establish standards other teams can adopt.</li> <li>Architect AI systems designed to prevent systemic failure, and lead the resolution of the most severe incidents tied to model safety or data integrity</li> <li>Build reusable AI capabilities, such as production-ready agent implementations built on proven architectures, fine-tuned models, or evaluation methodologies, that other engineers and clients can build on</li> <li>Advise on which new AI developments are worth adopting, and help set the technical roadmap for the domain</li> <li>Act as the senior technical partner to client leadership on AI strategy</li> <li>Coach Senior Applied AI Engineers, delegate ownership of technical domains, and build systems and practices that enable multiple teams to deliver safer AI</li> <li>Contribute to recruiting and representing Scale's AI work externally</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of engineering experience, with a multi-year track record owning AI/ML systems in production</li> <li>Experience judging the quality of training data, selecting the right adaptation method for a given model, evaluating fine-tuning results, and balancing serving cost, latency, and quality trade-offs</li> <li>Experience owning an AI-powered product end to end, including direct involvement in the AI's behaviour rather than implementing ML work scoped by another team</li> <li>A track record of establishing standards that outlived the projects they were built for, such as an evaluation methodology, an MLOps practice, or an architectural pattern</li> <li>Comfort operating with executive-level clients and leadership, including defending a technical position under pressure</li> <li>Deep experience with regulated, sovereign, or on-premise AI deployment, including hallucination mitigation and auditability</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where this role sits</strong></p> <p>Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.</p> <p><strong>The Public Sector context</strong></p> <p>Location, travel, and vetting requirements vary by assignment. We discuss assignment-specific eligibility early in the hiring process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE:&nbsp;</em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!
